title: 第2306章 狼本阳第2305章 赵纪
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
王尽二人被带到赵纪的面前。
此时，很多大乘境强者站在周围，盯着这两个人。
赵纪坐在主位上，冷冷地盯着王尽二人。
王尽二人大吃一惊，十分惊慌。
“王尽，古可，怎么只有你们两个人回来？王荒呢？”
赵纪沉声问道。
“赵大人，王荒已经战死了，对方的实力十分强大，一招就将王荒杀死了。”
王尽解释道。
“哦？王荒可是大乘境五重的修为，实力比你们二人要强大得多，怎么他死了，你们两个没有死？”
赵纪沉声道。
此时，周围人的神识都锁定这两个人，如果这两个人是叛徒的话，那么他们肯定会斩杀的。
任何势力都是极其痛恨叛徒的。
“赵大人，对方放我们二人回来，主要是让我们二人报信的，对方只有一个人，修为是大乘境，但是实力极其恐怖，对方说一定会找我们这支军队算账的，让我们等着就是。”
王尽开口道。
对于他们二人暴露军队消息的事情，只字不提。
否则，他们二人可没有什么好下场。
“没错，对方是放我们两个回来报信的，这是对我们这支大军的警告，我们二人害怕，担心对方说话不算数，不会饶过我们，我们一路上，多次转换方向，才回到营地里来，确认没有人跟踪。”
王尽继续道。
二人的表情极为诚恳。
现在看来，韦姓修士带领的那批精锐也是死完了。

接下来，赵纪再问了一些其他的问题，二人在半路上通过气，回答得还算可以，没法确认他们二人叛变。
“你们二人，回去吧，此事告一段落，将这个敌人的画像画下来，让我们所有人都警惕。”
赵纪道。
“是，我们二人回去，就将这个人的画像画出来。”
王尽道。
一旁的古可也是如此。
二人真是吓坏了。
现在总算是逃过一劫。
他们二人害怕江尘，同样害怕眼前的赵纪。
都是能决定他们二人生死的强者。
二人回去后，将江尘的画像画出来。
content_en:
Wang Jin and others were brought to Zhao Ji.
At this time, many Mahayana realm experts were standing around, staring at these two people.
Zhao Ji sat on the main seat and stared at Wang Jin and Wang coldly.
Wang Jin and Wang Jin were shocked and panicked.
"Wang Jin, Gu Ke, why are you two the only ones back? Where is Wang Huang?"
Zhao Ji asked in a deep voice.
"Master Zhao, Wang Huang has already died in the battle. The opponent is very powerful and killed Wang Huang in one move."
Wang Jin explained.
"Oh? Wang Huang is at the fifth level of the Mahayana realm and is much stronger than the two of you. Why is he dead but you two are not?"
Zhao Ji said in a deep voice.
At this time, the consciousness of the people around them was locked on these two people. If these two people were traitors, then they would definitely kill them.
Any force hates traitors extremely.
"Master Zhao, the other party let us two back, mainly to let us two report. There is only one person in the other party. His cultivation is in the Mahayana realm, but his strength is extremely terrifying. The other party said that he will definitely settle the score with our army, so we just need to wait."
Wang Jin opened his mouth and said.
Not a word was mentioned about the two of them exposing information about the army.
Otherwise, there will be no good end for the two of them.
"That's right, the other party let us two come back to report the news. This was a warning to our large army. The two of us were scared and worried that the other party would not keep their words and would not spare us. We changed directions many times along the way before returning to the camp to make sure that no one was following us."
Wang Jin continued.
The expressions of the two were extremely sincere.
Now it seems that the elite group led by the monk surnamed Wei are also dead.
Next, Zhao Ji asked some other questions. The two of them got angry halfway and answered fairly well. They could not confirm their rebellion.
"You two, go back. This matter is over. Draw a portrait of this enemy to make us all vigilant."
Zhao Jidao.
"Yes, the two of us will draw this person's portrait when we go back."
Wang Jindao.
The same goes for Gu Ke on the side.
The two of them were really frightened.
Now he finally escaped.
The two of them were afraid of Jiang Chen, and they were also afraid of Zhao Ji in front of them.
They are both strong men who can decide the life or death of the two of them.
After the two returned, they drew a portrait of Jiang Chen.
